## Context / Problem
This four-path cohort has four editable prose blocks: the initial header in each browser .mjs helper and the jira-cassette-loader.py module docstring. Condense them while correcting two factual contradictions.

Before-citations and inventory are pinned to origin/main@0033662b5534531d84e39d4a14bf75c8e768e85e. At repair time origin/main was 10533b1e3f651a60e8cea5691318c108ff1f3396; its intervening workflow/grounding changes did not touch these paths. Implement from current origin/main, but retain 0033662b5534531d84e39d4a14bf75c8e768e85e as the prose-audit basis. The leaf change is one commit, so changed-path checks use HEAD^..HEAD.

## Approach
In each .mjs file, edit only the initial contiguous // header ending in Usage:. Everything from the first import onward remains byte-identical. In jira-cassette-loader.py, edit only the module docstring and preserve #!/usr/bin/env python3 exactly as line 1.

For the Python file, parse base/final text with ast.parse(source, type_comments=True); recursively remove only the leading Expr(Constant(str)) from Module, ClassDef, FunctionDef, and AsyncFunctionDef bodies; normalize only ast.TypeIgnore.lineno; and require exact ast.dump(..., include_attributes=False) equality. Separately preserve the shebang and directive signature.

A non-author reviewer posts exactly four TSV rows:
path<TAB>anchor/kind<TAB>before-citation<TAB>after-citation<TAB>preserved-contract-or-consumer<TAB>before-words<TAB>after-words<TAB>semantic-preservation<TAB>bloat-removal<TAB>reviewer-session
Citations use full immutable before/final SHAs. Both verdicts must be PASS.

## Scope — four blocks
- tests/e2e/js/browser_batch_library.mjs — initial // header through Usage:. Preserve concise purpose and invocation.
- tests/e2e/js/browser_batch.mjs — initial // header through Usage:. Preserve concise purpose/invocation; runtime sections already express the scenario.
- tests/e2e/js/browser_structured.mjs — initial // header through Usage:. Preserve purpose, invocation, round-trip, validation, and no-loss expectations. Correct the claim that a raw-JSON fallback is present: runtime behavior and its consumer require the raw editor to be absent.
- tests/mocks/jira-cassette-loader.py — module docstring after the line-1 shebang. Correct "401/Retry-After" to the actual 429 plus Retry-After self-test. State matching exactly: uppercased method plus URL, ordered per-key cursor, then KeyError on exhaustion; request body is not matched.

## Consumers
- browser_batch_library.mjs: tests/e2e/test_editor_batch_library.py::test_editor_batch_library_select_and_author

- browser_structured.mjs: tests/e2e/test_editor_browser.py::test_editor_structured_fields_roundtrip_error_and_no_raw_editor
- jira-cassette-loader.py: its direct _self_test; no repository importer was found.
scripts/check_comment_hygiene.py is the deterministic prose-policy consumer. No targeted __doc__, inspect.getdoc, or doctest consumer was found.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Only the three initial // headers and one Python module docstring change; every block is shorter/current.
- [ ] Every .mjs byte from the first import onward is identical to 0033662b5534531d84e39d4a14bf75c8e768e85e.
- [ ] The cassette-loader normalized AST is identical to 0033662b5534531d84e39d4a14bf75c8e768e85e; its shebang remains exact on line 1 and its directive signature is unchanged.
- [ ] browser_structured documents no raw fallback; cassette-loader documents 429 and its actual matching/exhaustion contract.
- [ ] HEAD^..HEAD changes exactly the four recorded file-impact paths.
- [ ] The non-author TSV has exactly four PASS/PASS rows with full SHAs.
- [ ] All structured semantic, header/shebang, path, diff, hygiene, wrapper-test, self-test, node-check, and make-verify commands pass.

## Verification
Run every structured verify command. The prior pytest --collect-only command was invalid for .mjs files and a hyphenated helper; it is replaced by the real Python wrapper nodes, direct cassette self-test, and one node --check per .mjs file.
